reasoning: This glyph is an abstract UI control representing either a bottom panel/sheet toggle or a framed media eject symbol. Because it depicts interface chrome rather than a concrete real-world object or common user action, it has almost no natural fit for everyday to-do list tasks and is easily confused with upload or layout icons.
